fullPassage: We are exceptionally smart, and this helps us adapt to a wide range of environments. But we are not nearly smart enough as individuals to solve the adaptive problems that confronted modern humans as they spread across the globe. The package of tools, foraging techniques, ecological knowledge, and social arrangements used by any group of foragers being far too complex for any individual to create. We are able to learn all the things we need to know in each of the many different environments in which we live only because we acquire information from others. We are much better at learning from others than other species are, and we are motivated to learn from others even when we do not understand why our models are doing what they are doing. This psychology allows human populations to accumulate pools of adaptive information that greatly exceed the inventive capacities of individuals.

We are able to learn all the things we need to know in each of the many different __________ (environmental) in which we live.

questions.passage: We are exceptionally smart, and this helps us adapt to a wide range of environments. But we are not nearly smart enough as individuals to solve the adaptive problems that confronted modern humans as they spread across the globe. The package of tools, foraging techniques, ecological knowledge, and __________ used by any group of foragers being far too complex for any individual to create. We are able to learn all the things we need to know in each of the many different environments in which we live only because we acquire information from others. We are much better at learning from others than other species are, and we are motivated to learn from others even when we do not understand why our models are doing what they are doing. This psychology allows human populations to accumulate pools of adaptive information that greatly exceed the inventive capacities of individuals.

det.korean: 도구, 채집 기술, 생태학적 지식, 그리고 ____이 채집민 집단이 사용하는 패키지
det.analysis:
❌ ① adaptive information: '적응적 정보'는 뒤 문장의 결과물이지 패키지 구성 요소 아님
❌ ② individual capacities: '개인 역량'은 패키지의 구성 요소가 아닌 한계 대상
❌ ③ modern populations: '현대 인구'는 도구/기술/지식과 나열되기 부적절
✅ ④ social arrangements: '사회적 배치/체계'는 도구/기술/지식과 함께 나열되는 원문 구성 요소 ←정답
